title: Behavioural scorecard Gini below threshold - recalibration overdue
description: 2025 annual validation found Gini declined from 0.55 to 0.48, breaching the 0.50 monitoring threshold. Conditional approval required recalibration by Q4 2025, which has not been delivered.
remediation: Recalibrate model on refreshed 2023-2025 behavioural data; interim tightening of auto-renewal limits for borderline grades.

responses.author: Lina Haddad
responses.text: Recalibration workstream mobilised. Development sample (2023-2025 behavioural data) extracted and quality-checked; target delivery Q4 2026. Interim tightening of auto-renewal limits effective since March.

title: Annual revalidation overdue
description: Annual validation was due 28 Feb 2026 and has not been scheduled. Model is Tier 1 and continues in production use.
remediation: Commission periodic validation immediately; combine with recalibration review.

title: Bureau data quality assessment never completed
description: Initial 2023 validation condition to complete a formal data quality assessment for the credit bureau feed remains outstanding.
remediation: Complete DQ assessment as part of upcoming recalibration workstream.

title: Corporate rating override rate 31%
description: External validation found 31% of corporate ratings are overridden by credit officers, undermining model reliance and rating comparability. Override justifications frequently missing or generic.
remediation: Root-cause review of override drivers; recalibrate qualitative module weights; enforce structured override justification in workflow; monthly override reporting to MRC.

responses.author: Ahmed Al-Kuwari
responses.text: Structured override justification taxonomy deployed in the credit workflow in February. Q1 override rate reduced from 31% to 26%; monthly override reporting to MRC now live.

responses.author: Hassan Al-Mohannadi
responses.text: Progress acknowledged, but the rate remains above the 15% validation condition. Issue remains open past due date — escalated to the Model Risk Committee.

title: Override documentation weaknesses (Internal Audit)
description: Internal Audit rated override governance 'Needs Improvement': 40% of sampled overrides lacked documented justification.
remediation: Mandatory justification field with taxonomy implemented in credit workflow; retrospective documentation of 2025 overrides.

title: Guarantee claims 40% above model expectation
description: Targeted validation found realised Al Dhameen claims materially exceed model expectation in the manufacturing segment. Claim frequency assumption relies on stale partner-bank data (2019-2021 vintage).
remediation: Full redevelopment of claim frequency component using 2022-2026 program data; conservative interim overlay of +35% applied to expected claims; quarterly claims backtest reporting to MRC until closure.

responses.author: Rajesh Nair
responses.text: Redevelopment of the claim frequency component initiated using 2022-2026 program data. Conservative interim overlay of +35% applied to expected claims in the April cycle.

title: No ongoing monitoring plan in place
description: Model has no documented ongoing monitoring plan; claims deviation was detected via finance reporting rather than model monitoring.
remediation: Define monitoring KPIs (claims ratio, portfolio mix drift) with thresholds and quarterly reporting.
owner: Yousef Al-Emadi (Head of Al Dhameen Program)

title: Equipment-collateral LGD segment under-predicts losses
description: 2025 external validation found the equipment collateral segment under-predicts realised losses (backtest ratio 1.24). Portfolio-level impact currently modest.
remediation: Re-estimate equipment recovery rates with expanded workout dataset; apply interim segment overlay in ECL computation.

title: Recovery data quality assessment outstanding since 2024
description: Condition from initial validation (Nov 2024) to complete formal data quality assessment of workout/recovery data remains open.
remediation: Complete DQ assessment; establish recovery data capture standards in collections workflow.

title: Macro scenario model in production without validation or approval
description: The macroeconomic scenario and overlay model has been used in ECL production since Q3 2025 without independent validation or Model Risk Committee approval. Scenario weights and overlays materially affect reported provisions.
remediation: Immediate: document current methodology and freeze scenario weights pending review. Commission independent validation; present to MRC for conditional approval; complete documentation suite.

responses.author: Fatima Al-Sulaiti
responses.text: Methodology documented and scenario weights frozen as at February. RFP for independent validation issued to three firms; MRC conditional-approval paper drafted.

title: Documentation suite incomplete
description: Methodology document, data quality assessment, user guide and monitoring plan do not exist for this Tier 1 model.
remediation: Complete full documentation suite to Tier 1 standard as prerequisite for validation.

title: Annual revalidation overdue for Tier 1 liquidity model
description: Annual validation was due 15 June 2026 and has not been commissioned. The 2025 validation condition (re-estimation of government-related deposit runoff assumptions) is also outstanding.
remediation: Commission external validation immediately; complete runoff assumption re-estimation as validation input.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

title: Government-related deposit runoff assumptions stale
description: Behavioural runoff assumptions for government-related deposits are based on pre-2024 data and may understate stress outflows following funding structure changes.
remediation: Re-estimate using post-2024 deposit behaviour; sensitivity-test survival horizon to revised assumptions.

title: AML scenario thresholds untuned - false positive rate 91%
description: Majority of monitoring scenarios still operate at vendor default thresholds. False positive rate of 91% drives alert backlog and dilutes investigator focus on genuine suspicious activity.
remediation: Complete statistically supported threshold tuning for all remaining scenarios with above/below-the-line testing; monthly backlog reporting to Board Compliance Committee until cleared.

title: Alert backlog above appetite (Internal Audit)
description: Internal Audit found the alert investigation backlog exceeded the 30-day disposition standard for 45% of alerts.
remediation: Temporary investigation surge team stood up; backlog reduced within standard as of May 2026.

title: Manual satellite-model data transfers
description: Data transfers from satellite risk models into the capital projection engine are manual spreadsheet-based, creating operational risk in ICAAP production.
remediation: Automate data interfaces as part of the risk data aggregation roadmap (BCBS 239 alignment).

title: Startup segment population shift
description: PSI of 0.09 in the startup segment reflects changing applicant mix following new government entrepreneurship initiatives. Below action threshold but trending upward.
remediation: Quarterly PSI monitoring at segment level; assess need for startup-specific module at next annual validation.

title: Wider IPV variance on illiquid sukuk
description: Independent price verification variance exceeds 50bps for a small number of illiquid sukuk positions; mitigated by IPV overlay but indicates vendor pricing limitations.
remediation: Maintain challenger DCF pricing for affected names; review materiality quarterly.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)
